newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends easier vs dlr, steady vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends easier vs dlr, steady vs basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint eased against the dollar on Friday on the mark's losses, but remained steady versus the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) currency basket, dealers said.
"We remained at the NBH bid (NBH resistance level)," said Istvan Gere of ING Bank.
The forint tracked the dollar/mark and finished at 185.45/50, compared with its opening 185.22/27, dealers said.
They added they did not see factors to move the forint away from the NBH bid in the near future.
(The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide. The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
